title: Circular queue histories and reference-array fill
summary: Commons Collections queue histories and Commons Lang ArrayFill observe replacement, identity and covariant array stores.

subject.system: Circular queue histories and reference-array fill

change.description: Commons Collections queue histories and Commons Lang ArrayFill observe replacement, identity and covariant array stores.

notes: The opening comparison uses the released JARs and Temurin 21.0.13. The standalone, ordinary native, integrated JBMC and physical JVM evidence is measured per statement.

The independent two-slot oracle checked all 256 histories. Full occupancy disagreed with isFull on 128. Reference fill preserves the array and replacement identity and checks covariance on the first store.
